name: postslap
title: Postslap
description: Write once and publish with your local Postslap sessions.
author: local

commands.name: postslap
commands.title: Postslap
commands.description: Compose, attach images, and publish inside Raycast using your local Postslap API.

commands.name: publish-background
commands.title: Finish Publishing
commands.description: Finishes a saved Postslap submission in the background and shows its result.

preferences.name: projectPath
preferences.title: Postslap Project Folder
preferences.description: Local folder containing storage/client-token. Social sessions stay in Postslap.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist -o dist
scripts.lint: eslint src && prettier --check src package.json tsconfig.json README.md eslint.config.mjs
